name: passed
doc_comment: Returns true only when every case in the suite passed.

name: run_fixture_suite
doc_comment:
Runs the bundled weekly-email smoke fixture and reports whether parsing
preserved the complete line count and produced non-empty structured data.

name: FixtureCaseReport
doc_comment: Outcome and human-readable evidence for one named regression fixture.

name: FixtureReport
doc_comment: Named collection of fixture cases returned to tests or external harnesses.

name: success
doc_comment: Constructs a successful envelope while preserving advisory diagnostics.
signature: fn success(data: T, diagnostics: Vec<CoreDiagnostic>) -> Self

name: failure
doc_comment:
Constructs a failed envelope with no data and the evidence explaining
both the blocking error and any additional diagnostics.
signature: fn failure(error: CoreError, diagnostics: Vec<CoreDiagnostic>) -> Self

name: CoreResult
doc_comment:
Stable API envelope that carries either data or a typed error plus any
non-fatal diagnostics gathered while producing the result.

name: CoreError
doc_comment: Machine-stable failure code paired with an operator-readable explanation.

name: CoreDiagnostic
doc_comment: Non-fatal or supporting evidence with optional source-line context.

name: CoreDiagnosticKind
doc_comment: Domain that produced a diagnostic, allowing the UI to route it correctly.

name: DiagnosticSeverity
doc_comment: Operator-facing urgency of a diagnostic independent of its domain.

name: ParsedBatch
doc_comment: Lossless line-oriented result of parsing one raw promotion source.

name: ParsedLineRecord
doc_comment:
One physical source line with normalized text, classification, supplier
resolution, and immutable provenance back to the original input.

name: DealTag
doc_comment:
Structural role assigned to a parsed source line; unknown and ignored input
remain explicit variants so the parser never drops uncertainty silently.

name: SectionKind
doc_comment: High-level email section that may constrain supplier and deal interpretation.

name: SupplierResolution
doc_comment:
Typed supplier-linkage outcome that distinguishes confident identity,
bounded ambiguity, policy ineligibility, unresolved context, and no evidence.

name: Provenance
doc_comment: Origin and one-based source line needed to explain or repair derived data.

name: DealSource
doc_comment: Authorized origin of a deal observation or operator-authored correction.

name: validate_website_export_core
doc_comment:
Accepts only rows with supplier identity and customer-facing deal copy.
Zero recognized rows fail closed as an incompatible export; mixed exports
succeed with warnings and retain only recognized deal rows.

name: WebsiteExportBatch
doc_comment:
Recognized website deal rows plus explicit accounting for every inspected
record, allowing partial exports to surface discarded-row diagnostics.

name: CopywritingStep
doc_comment:
Manages the manual AI-copy workflow from prompt generation through lint
review, targeted repair, completion tracking, and field-by-field clipboard
handoff. Generated copy remains session data until the operator explicitly
accepts warnings and checks each deal complete.

name: Modal
parseRawToGroups
doc_comment:
Parses tagged `v`/`d`/`ed` text into ordered vendor groups for AI prompting.
Deal IDs are stable within the parsed batch, exclusivity comes only from the
`ed` tag, and orphan deal lines are ignored rather than assigned to the wrong
supplier.

name: cleanAndParseJSON
doc_comment:
Extracts the outer JSON array from an AI response and tolerates trailing
commas. Structural cardinality and factual safety are validated separately
by `validateAndMerge`.

name: generatePrompt
doc_comment:
Produces the batch copywriting prompt while preserving vendor and deal order
as a cardinality contract. The prompt requires structured dates, forbids
supplier names and expiry dates in customer copy, and embeds the editable
house style without trusting the AI output as validated data.

name: generateSingleDealPrompt
doc_comment:
Builds a narrowly scoped repair prompt for one selected deal, including its
source, current copy, exclusivity, house style, and optional operator note.
The requested response is one bare JSON object suitable for patch parsing.
signature:
function generateSingleDealPrompt({
  vendorName,
  deal,
  note = "",
  currentHeadline = "",
  currentDescription = "",
  houseStyle = DEFAULT_HOUSE_STYLE,
})

name: createDealSlug
validateDeal
doc_comment:
Compares proposed customer copy with its source deal and returns actionable
findings for material drift, leaked codes, suspect dates, excessive length,
and exclusivity formatting. Ordinary marketing paraphrases are allowed;
errors represent blockers while warnings require operator judgment.

name: validateAndMerge
doc_comment:
Validates an entire AI response against the source batch before constructing
editable deal rows. Vendor or per-vendor deal-count changes fail closed;
accepted rows retain source provenance, receive unique slugs, and aggregate
per-deal lint findings for the review gate.

name: cleanAndParsePatchJSON
doc_comment:
Extracts a single-deal repair payload from a bare object, vendor wrapper, or
batch-shaped array and tolerates trailing commas. Semantic targeting is left
to `extractDealPatch` and `applyDealPatch`.

name: extractDealPatch
doc_comment:
Normalizes supported repair-response shapes into one patch and fills missing
identity fields from the deal the operator selected. Empty or malformed
wrapper shapes fail explicitly instead of patching an arbitrary row.

name: applyDealPatch
doc_comment:
Applies a normalized repair to exactly one copied deal using stable ID or
vendor/deal position, then rebuilds the final description and reruns lint.
The input group tree is cloned so session updates remain immutable.

name: appendDealToRawInput
doc_comment:
Inserts a quick-added deal beneath an existing tagged supplier or appends a
new supplier block. The helper validates non-empty operator input and emits
the same `v`/`d`/`ed` format consumed by the rest of the pipeline.

name: DEFAULT_HOUSE_STYLE
doc_comment: Default operator-editable policy embedded in batch and repair prompts.

name: loadDealCore
doc_comment: Initializes the generated WASM module before any typed core operation.

name: parseRawEmail
doc_comment:
Initializes the WASM core and parses raw email text into lossless records with
source-line provenance and typed supplier resolution. Parser uncertainty is
returned as diagnostics or explicit supplier states, never hidden by a
JavaScript-side fallback interpretation.

name: validateWebsiteExport
doc_comment:
Sends operator-supplied website rows through the versioned WASM schema
boundary before dedupe consumes them. The result distinguishes inspected,
recognized, and ignored rows and carries diagnostics instead of treating an
arbitrary JSON array as current-catalog truth.

name: CoreResult
doc_comment: JSON-compatible success/failure envelope shared across the WASM boundary.

name: WebsiteExportBatch
doc_comment: Accepted website rows plus accounting for inspected and discarded records.

name: norm
doc_comment:
Produces the accent-insensitive, punctuation-neutral supplier key used by
catalog, alias, ambiguity, and family lookups. It is a comparison key, not a
customer-facing supplier label.

name: resolveVendor
doc_comment:
Resolves an observed supplier label without guessing across known
ambiguities. The result records canonical identity, family membership,
match provenance, candidate names, and whether the supplier may be emitted
by the tagging pipeline; unknown labels remain explicitly `unknown`.

name: canonicalVendor
doc_comment:
Returns the canonical supplier name when resolution succeeds, otherwise the
cleaned observed label. Use `resolveVendor` when ambiguity or eligibility
must remain visible to the caller.

name: isTagEligibleSupplier
doc_comment:
Reports whether a supplier label is safe to emit as a recognized `v` record.
Recognition and tag eligibility are intentionally separate because some
known brands must remain visible for review but cannot enter automation.

name: vendorFamily
doc_comment:
Returns the stable family key used to place HQ and website deals in the same
dedupe candidate pool. Unknown names receive a normalized fallback key so
unrelated suppliers are not collapsed into a shared unknown bucket.

name: supplierCatalog
doc_comment: Canonical supplier records enriched with the default normalized family key.

name: suppliers
doc_comment: Read-only presentation projection used by supplier selectors and links.

name: aliases
doc_comment: Normalized observed labels mapped to their canonical supplier names.

name: familyOf
doc_comment: Canonical supplier name to dedupe-family key, including declared brand families.

name: supplierNames
doc_comment: Canonical supplier names in catalog order for lightweight UI enumeration.

name: parseRawEmail
doc_comment:
@param {string} raw_text
@returns {any}

name: validateWebsiteExport
doc_comment:
@param {any} rows
@returns {any}

name: parse_raw_email
doc_comment:
Parses raw email text for JavaScript callers and serializes the complete
result envelope, including diagnostics, into JSON-compatible `JsValue`.

name: validate_website_export
doc_comment:
Validates a JavaScript website-export value without panicking on incompatible
input; deserialization failures become a typed `CoreResult` error.

name: parse_raw_email_core
doc_comment:
Preserves every physical source line with stable line provenance while the
core parser is incrementally developed. Supplier headings establish context
for following deal lines, and uncertainty remains typed rather than guessed.

name: App
doc_comment:
Owns the three-step workflow shell and the durable browser session shared by
Tag, Dedupe, and Copy. Step handoffs deliberately reset downstream derived
state, while the global reset clears persisted work and remounts every step.

name: DealtagStep
doc_comment:
Presents raw-email tagging as a reviewable two-pane operation. It delegates
classification to `transform`, keeps input and output scrolling aligned, and
hands only the operator-reviewed tagged text to the Dedupe step.
signature: function DealtagStep({ session, onSessionChange, onComplete, showToast })

name: transform
doc_comment:
Converts a raw weekly promotion email into the tagged `v`/`d`/`ed` text
consumed by dedupe and copywriting. Supplier headings establish context for
following deals; unresolved headings and deals become `X` records when
`includeUnknowns` is true so uncertain source material is never silently lost.
Returns both the tagged text and counts used by the Tag-step review UI.

name: filterAcceptedTaggedText
doc_comment:
Returns only records accepted by Tag for downstream processing.
X rows remain visible in the Tag review output, but they are terminal
exclusions and must never cross the Tag -> Dedupe boundary.

name: DedupeStep
doc_comment:
Orchestrates website-export validation, supplier-scoped matching, and human
review of matched, extension, unmatched, and excluded deals. Matcher inputs
are frozen into `lastRun`, rejected match proposals return to unmatched, and
only the reviewed unmatched set is handed to Copywriting.
signature: function DedupeStep({ session, onSessionChange, onComplete, showToast })

name: sameDay
doc_comment: Compares two present dates by local calendar day rather than timestamp.

name: parseHQDates
doc_comment:
Extracts the booking window encoded in terse HQ deal text using Los Angeles
calendar semantics. Ongoing offers have no end date, malformed years become
`dateWarning` evidence instead of guessed dates, and an omitted year rolls
forward only when the inferred date would otherwise already be past.

name: createStage
signature: function createStage(key, label, delta, reasons, details)

name: resetIds
doc_comment: Resets batch-local HQ identifiers before reparsing frozen source text.

name: parseHQ
doc_comment:
Parses tagged source text into normalized HQ deal records for matching.
Vendor context comes only from accepted `v` lines; terminal `X` exclusions
are ignored. Deal records retain the original line, supplier resolution
status, dates, exclusivity, and the feature bag used by scoring stages.

name: ingestWebsiteJSON
doc_comment:
Adapts validated website-export rows into the comparison shape used by the
matcher. It preserves each raw row while normalizing supplier identity,
family, dates, display text, and feature evidence; schema acceptance belongs
to the upstream website-export validator rather than this adapter.

name: runFullMatch
doc_comment:
Builds supplier-family candidate pools and assigns each HQ deal at most one
website candidate using the staged scoring and optimal-matching policy.
Missing website candidates remain explicit unmatched results, and an optional
supplier filter narrows HQ work without changing the candidate evidence.

name: categorizeDedupeResults
doc_comment:
Partitions comparison results into explicit, count-conserving outcomes.
Operator exclusions and the optional ending-today rule are terminal: neither
outcome is eligible for the Copy payload.

name: exportUnmatched
doc_comment:
Serializes reviewed unmatched HQ records back to canonical tagged text for
the Copy step, preserving exclusivity and grouping suppliers alphabetically.

name: dateFmt
doc_comment: Shared Los Angeles date formatter used by the operator-facing match UI.
